thesis: Progressive Corp (NYSE: PGR), largest US personal auto insurer plus commercial lines and property. 10-Q for Q3 2026 (accession 0000080661-26-000379, filed 2026-11-02) and Q3 8-K release (0000080661-26-000367, 2026-10-14). Q3 net premiums written 22,301M (+4%), earned 21,869M (+5%), net income 2,542M (-3%, EPS 4.37 vs 4.45), combined ratio 88.7 (89.5); 9M 2026 net income 8,671M (EPS 14.83 vs 14.21), combined ratio 87.5, NPW 67,019M (+5%). Policies in force 40.49M (+6%). September NPW growth slowed to +2% (companywide), personal lines +1%. Equity 34,485M, debt 8,389M, investments 99,197M, BVPS 59.51 (release). TTM net income about 11,622M (FY2025 11,308 - 9M25 8,357 + 9M26 8,671); TTM diluted EPS 19.85, so 11.9x at the 235.78 close (2026-11-13), P/B 4.0x on BVPS, TTM ROE about 33% on average of Sept 2025 and Sept 2026 equity. Market cap about 136.6B (579.36M shares on 10-Q cover, 2026-10-01). Dividends paid 9M 2026 were 8,088M (about 5.9% of market cap; the annual variable dividend paid in January, funded partly by selling investments per the 10-Q). Market view: priced for a peak margin period as growth decelerates; evidence against that is 9M combined ratio 87.5 with unit growth +6%. What closes the gap: continued mid single digit growth with combined ratio below 95. Sector model: P&C insurer, so earnings, combined ratio, book value and reserves, not generic FCF (OCF 9M 12,492M, capex 317M reported but not used as owner earnings).
counterthesis: Auto insurance margins are cyclical: a 87.5 combined ratio invites competition, rate cuts and ad spending, and September NPW growth already slowed to +2% with Direct and Agency vehicle premiums +1%. Q4 has hurricane and winter catastrophe exposure and Florida/Texas weather; prior-year reserve development, litigation and tariff driven repair cost inflation were not read in the MD&A. September had pretax realized losses of 231M and a comprehensive loss of 679M, showing rate sensitivity of 99B of investments. The 2025 comparison includes a 950M policyholder credit expense (Florida excess profit related per release; cause not fully read), flattering YTD growth. The variable dividend is discretionary and funded by selling investments. At 4.0x book the stock already assumes sustained high ROE; peers (ALL, TRV, CB, GEICO as part of BRK) and PGR's own historical multiple were not compared.
invalidation: Thesis fails if the companywide combined ratio runs above about 95 for two quarters, NPW growth turns negative, adverse prior-year reserve development appears, or the stock reaches a multiple that prices peak margins as permanent without growth.
